question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Carry on
solution:
The correct answer is **'Continue doing something'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate meaning of the given phrase **'Carry on' **is **'Continue doing something'.**
 
• **Carry on:** to continue to do or be involved with something. (कुछ करना जारी रखना या उसमें शामिल होना)
 
 
• *Example: You’ve got to** carry on **as though nothing happened.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Continue doing something.*
